summary: Here Group Ltd, a Hong Kong-domiciled, NASDAQ-listed pop toy company (a US-equivalent Form 6-K foreign private issuer current report), furnished unaudited Q4/FY2026 results alongside a disclosure titled change to board and management. FY2026 revenue was RMB596.8 million with a net loss from continuing operations of RMB254.9 million, including a RMB124.1 million goodwill impairment; the prior business was disposed September 30, 2025 and reported as discontinued operations. Peng Li remains Chairman and CEO. No successor, departure terms, or effective date is specified in the excerpt, so the management-change characterization is uncertain and the filing is otherwise routine earnings disclosure. Watch for a subsequent 6-K clarifying board composition, departures, and any governance or strategy implications.
